content.title: 2026 Valero Texas Open Saturday tee times: Round 3 groupings
content.text: Ludvig Aberg is four shots back at the 2026 Valero Texas Open halfway point. Getty Images The 2026 Valero Texas Open continues on Saturday, April 4, with the third round at TPC San Antonio’s Oaks Course in Texas. You can find full Valero Texas Open tee times for Saturday’s third round at the bottom of this post.Featured tee time for Round 3After firing rounds of 66-64, Scotland’s Robert MacIntyre (-14) holds a commanding lead at the Valero Texas Open halfway point, with a four-shot advantage over his closest competitor, Ludvig Aberg (-10).MacIntyre has two career PGA Tour wins, which occurred in close succession nearly two years ago: the 2024 Genesis Scottish Open and the 2024 RBC Canadian Open. MacIntyre has been in good form so far this season, posting two top-4 finishes since January, including a fourth-place finish at the Players Championship last month.Aberg is also seeking his third career victory after claiming his first two titles at the 2023 RSM Classic and the 2025 Genesis Invitational.MacIntyre and Aberg will play alongside Kevin Roy in Saturday’s final grouping at 11:11 a.m.You can watch Saturday’s third round of the 2026 Valero Texas Open from 11 a.m.-3:30 p.m. ET on Golf Channel, followed by the NBC broadcast from 3:30-6 p.m. PGA Tour Live on ESPN+ will provide exclusive early streaming coverage starting at 9 a.m. ET on Saturday in addition to featured group and featured hole coverage.Check out the complete Round 3 tee times and groupings for the Valero Texas Open below.Hoping to wager on the Valero Texas Open?
